description: The / list over the box you write in: Baude's own commands and what they say.

messages.cd: Move the conversation to another folder
messages.btw: Ask a side question: answered from this conversation, without adding to it
messages.login: Sign in to your Anthropic account (claude auth login)
messages.logout: Sign out of your Anthropic account (claude auth logout)
messages.cd_elsewhere: /cd is this machine's: a session on {$host} stays in its folder there
messages.cd_busy: Wait for the current turn to finish (or Stop it) before changing folder
